title: Track unpaid invoices and draft payment reminders
summary: A developer built InvoicePilot, an agent that reads invoice photos, saves the details locally, answers questions like which invoices are overdue, and drafts reminder emails; tested only on samples.
agent_role: The agent reads invoice images, picks the right tool to save or query invoices, and drafts reminder emails. The user confirms extracted fields before saving.
outcome: Author says it has only been used on his own sample invoices, with no outside users yet.
what_they_did: The developer built a local invoice helper for freelancers. You upload an invoice photo, a vision model pulls out the client, amount and due date, and you confirm before it saves to a local database. You can then ask plain questions and get a polite reminder email draft.
how_it_went: The author tested it only on his own sample invoices. He says this showed users would want PDF support, a way to fix misread dates, and marking invoices as paid.
worth_knowing: The post says the vision model runs locally but names a Gemini cloud model for it, so check where invoice images actually go if privacy matters.
prompt: Read the invoice images in [folder]. For each, extract the client name, amount, invoice date and due date, and show them to me to confirm before saving to [spreadsheet]. Then list which invoices are overdue as of today, with days overdue and total owed per client. Draft a short, polite reminder email for each overdue invoice that states the exact amount and due date. Do not send anything; show me the drafts for approval.

curation.rationale: A genuine small agent that reads invoices, stores them and drafts reminders, with code available, but tested only on the author's own samples with no reported results. Finance angle gives a small boost.
